name: Clone Mining Tycoon [ALPHA]
desc:
🌟 Welcome to Clone Mining Tycoon 🌟 Dig a huge mineshaft to the depths of the Earth! Your progress saves. Earn money by selling rare ores and finding chests deep underground. You can hire a huge number of miner workers to help you! Join the group, Elemental XYZ, for updates and awesomeness! 👍 If you enjoy our game, please leave a Like and Favourite - it would mean a lot to us! 

CREDITS 🔨 
Developer - wickedorange23 😃
